planets.name: Kepler-102 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-102 with a 16.1-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-102 e was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around Kepler-102. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
